title: Kufa, Wadi Al Salam & Imam Ali Shrine
full_text:
Head to Najaf.
Head to the Grand Mosque of Kufa, one of the earliest mosques in Islam.
Also visit the house of Imam Ali.
Visit the “Valley of Peace”, the world’s largest cemetery, before checking into the hotel.
At night, we will visit the shrine of Imam Ali, and tour the Najaf Grand Bazaar.
